meta.title: Electromagination
meta.author: Filippp
meta.description: The soundtrack of Electromagination by Filippp (2024-11-09). 32K executable music that placed 4th in the combined music competition at Comparade 2024. 120 BPM, 2:18, 10 tracks, 2118 notes. Instruments: 1 Falcon (FM synth), 2 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 4 Thunder (GSM sample player). Effects: 1 Leveller, 1 Crusher, 2 Chamber. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by -0.42 dB loudness and at most 0.98 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
